open_jobs.job_description:
We're seeking a Full Stack Developer to help build our next-generation SaaS platform. This role is ideal for someone with a Computer Science background who wants to work across the entire stack.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop full-stack web applications
- Build RESTful APIs using Python/FastAPI or Node.js
- Create responsive frontend interfaces with React
- Work with PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases
- Implement authentication and authorization
- Write unit and integration tests
- Deploy applications to AWS cloud infrastructure
- Participate in architectural decisions
- Troubleshoot and optimize application performance

Required Qualifications:
- BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
- 1-3 years of professional development experience
- Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python
- Experience with React and modern frontend frameworks
- Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases
- Understanding of RESTful API design
- Familiarity with Git and Agile methodologies
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
